terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The terms for using Groom Here to book salon appointments.

intro.title: About these terms
intro.body: These terms govern your use of the Groom Here platform (the website and its services) for booking appointments at salons and barbershops in Saudi Arabia. By using the platform or creating an account you accept them and the privacy policy.

service.title: The service
service.body: Groom Here shows the free times of participating salons, records your booking and sends you confirmations. The service itself is provided by the salon, which is responsible for its quality, prices, durations and specialists. The platform is a booking intermediary and provides no grooming services.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You sign up with your Saudi mobile number; we may ask for a verification code when needed. You are responsible for the accuracy of your details and for bookings made from your account, and you should tell us if you think someone else is using it. You must be 18 or older, or have a guardian book for you.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.body: A booking holds a time with a specific specialist for one or more services. Some bookings need the salon’s confirmation; their status shows on “My appointments”. Prices are the salon’s at the time of booking, and you pay at the salon; no money is paid through the platform.

cancel.title: Cancelling and changing
cancel.body: You can cancel or change your appointment for free from the booking page until it starts, unless another deadline was shown when you booked. If you have not arrived a quarter of an hour after the start, the salon may record a no-show.

changes.title: Changes by the salon
changes.body: In an emergency the salon may give your booking to another specialist at the same time, or offer you a new time. After a change of specialist you are told and may cancel or change until the appointment starts. An offered new time applies only if you accept it, and is held for you until an hour before your original appointment. The salon may also cancel a booking, giving a reason.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: You can review a completed visit once within the review period. Reviews show your first name and the initial of your family name. Write an honest review of your experience; we may hide abusive or misleading reviews, or reviews containing personal data.

loyalty.title: Loyalty programmes
loyalty.body: A salon may offer a loyalty card stamped by your completed visits through the platform; a full card becomes a reward whose terms and validity the salon sets. Rewards cannot be exchanged for cash or moved to another account.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Do not use the platform for fake or repeated bookings meant to harm a salon, and do not try to reach other people’s data or disrupt the platform. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We take reasonable care that times and information are correct, but they come from the salons and may change. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for the service given at the salon or for arrangements made directly between the customer and the salon.

updates.title: Changes to these terms
updates.body: We may update these terms and show the date of the last update at the top of the page. We will tell you about material changes before they take effect; continuing to use the platform afterwards means you accept them.

law.title: Governing law and contact
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. For any question or complaint, contact the Groom Here team through the platform’s WhatsApp number your booking messages come from, or from your account page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Groom Here handles your personal data.

intro.title: About this policy
intro.body: This policy explains how the Groom Here platform collects, uses and protects your personal data, and your rights over it, under Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law and its regulations.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: Your mobile number and name, your email if you add one, and your preferred language. Your bookings: the salon, services, specialist, time, your note and the booking’s status. Your reviews, favourites, loyalty cards and rewards. Technical data needed to run your account safely, such as sign-in sessions, the device and browser type, and a coded form of the IP address that does not reveal the address itself. If a salon books for you in person or by phone, it may record your name and mobile number with the booking.

purposes.title: Why we collect it
purposes.body: To create your account and carry out your bookings; to send confirmations, reminders and changes by WhatsApp and in the platform; to protect accounts and prevent misuse; to improve the service with statistics that do not identify you; and to meet legal obligations. We process your data to provide the service you asked for, for our legitimate interest in the platform’s security, and with your consent where required.

sharing.title: Who sees it
sharing.body: The salon you booked sees your name, the booking and your note, never your mobile number. The only exception: a booking the salon recorded itself, in person or by phone, shows that number to the barber until the visit is finished, then it disappears from the shop. Authorised Groom Here staff see your data only when needed; service providers we use (such as hosting and Meta’s WhatsApp messaging) see what they need; and authorities may receive it on a lawful request. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.

transfer.title: Processing outside the Kingdom
transfer.body: Some data may be processed by providers outside Saudi Arabia, such as WhatsApp messages sent through Meta, under the legal safeguards for data sent abroad and only as far as needed to provide the service.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data while your account exists. When you delete your account we delete your personal data or make it no longer linked to you, keeping only what the law requires or what an open dispute needs, and only for as long as needed. Booking records the salons need remain without your mobile number.

location.title: Your location
location.body: The location you choose is kept in a cookie on your device, rounded to about 100 metres, and sent as you browse to sort salons by distance. We do not save it in your account or in our records.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: We send booking confirmations, reminders and changes by WhatsApp to your number only, and notices in the platform. We send no marketing messages without your consent.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only Groom Here’s own cookies, no advertising or third-party cookies: sign-in session and security cookies, the site language and theme, the location you chose (rounded), one that keeps your current booking choices until you finish, and, when you scan a salon’s QR code, one that keeps that visit’s number for 7 days so your booking is credited to the code. We do not store the IP address of whoever scans a code, only a coded value of it that changes every day, to count visits.

security.title: Keeping your data safe
security.body: We encrypt your mobile number when storing it, use encrypted connections, limit our staff’s access by role, and log every time our staff reveals a mobile number. No protection is perfect; if a breach affects your data we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may know how we process your data, see it and ask for a copy, correct it from your account page, delete your account from “My details” once your coming bookings are cancelled or over, and withdraw your consent where processing relies on it. You may also complain to the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA).

contact.title: Contact and updates
contact.body: For any request about your data, contact the Groom Here team through the platform’s WhatsApp number your booking messages come from; we reply within the legal period. We may update this policy and show the date of the last update at the top of the page, and we will tell you about material changes before they take effect.
